summary: Jeep slid sideways near the end of a trail on a hillside, team winched it about 8 feet sideways up the hill over several hours with multiple re-riggings; recovered without a scratch
notes: Date: report posted 2017-06-21 (Wednesday) says mission was "Monday" -> 2017-06-19. Double-header recovery with the Chevy pickup (separate row). Occupant count unstated; report says "got them out". 16-hour day for the volunteer, two separate winch teams.
